Scan with the fleetd app on your phone:

<QR>

Pairing code: CODE  (single use, valid until TIME)
Grants:       admin on every machine
Hub address:  http://devbox.example:4799
  or:         http://127.0.0.1:4799
Pairing link: fleetd://pair?hub=http%3A%2F%2Fdevbox.example%3A4799&code=CODE

The fleetd app on this machine pairs by itself when it opens. On a phone, scan the QR with the
fleetd app. On another device, enter the code and hub address above in the app, or open the link there.
